text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
—No, pardon me. There was something about it that...
well, could serve as reference for training.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I spoke harshly before, but
your coaching has many good points as well.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I can tell that you are watching over
your Umamusume with great care.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...I look forward to your future successes.
